title: Pipeline Run generates candidate Statements
user_visible_behavior: Running the pipeline for an Election produces a candidate Dataset Version containing topic-tagged Statements derived from the Source Documents.
verification: pytest with the fake provider: the run creates a Dataset Version in `candidate` with N Statements
The Pipeline Run moves through queued → running → validating
notes: Prompt rules: neutral wording, a single proposition per Statement. Version the prompts.

title: Pipeline Run extracts Party Positions with Evidence
user_visible_behavior: For every Statement and Party, the run stores a position (−2..+2 or no stance) with a verbatim quote and a page or URL locator.
verification: pytest with the fake provider: every Statement × Party pair has a position, and non-`no stance` positions have Evidence
notes: For coalitions, the joint manifesto takes precedence over member manifestos. Chunk long manifestos.

title: Validation verifies Evidence quotes exist in the source
user_visible_behavior: A run fails Validation when any Evidence quote isn't found in its Source Document text (normalized match), and the report names the offending positions.
verification: pytest: an invented quote → failed with a report entry; real quotes with whitespace or accent differences → pass
notes: Check 2 in docs/domain-model.md. The match tolerance is an implementation-time decision.

title: Validation enforces minimum Party coverage
user_visible_behavior: A run fails if any Party has positions on less than the configured share (default 70%) of Statements.
verification: pytest: a party with 60% coverage → failed; 70% → pass; the threshold can be configured
notes: Check 3. Initial position: fail the whole run.

title: Validation rejects Statements that don't separate parties
user_visible_behavior: A run fails if any Statement has the same position for every Party.
verification: pytest: one Statement with every position equal → failed with that Statement named
notes: Check 4. Positions of `no stance` are ignored for this check.

title: Validation checks Statement count, uniqueness and topic spread
user_visible_behavior: A run fails if the Statement count is out of range, Statements are duplicated, or one topic exceeds the configured share.
verification: pytest: 20 Statements → failed; duplicates → failed; 50% of Statements on one topic → failed; a valid set → pass
notes: Checks 1, 5 and 6. Detecting compound propositions can be heuristic.

title: Passing runs auto-publish; failing runs keep the previous version
user_visible_behavior: When every Validation check passes, the Dataset Version becomes Published and the previous one is superseded; when one fails, the previous Published version stays live.
verification: pytest: pass → published with exactly one Published version per Election; fail → previous version unchanged
notes: Superseded versions stay readable for old Share Links.

title: Operator can inspect a Pipeline Run report
user_visible_behavior: A CLI command shows a run's status, provider, model, prompt version, duration, token or cost estimate, and the Validation report.
verification: pytest: the report command prints the stored fields for a passed run and a failed run
notes: Observability per docs/technical-discovery.md. Read-only: AI output cannot be edited.

title: Live mode starts a run when a Source Document changes
user_visible_behavior: With GENERATION_MODE=live, adding a Source Document or changing its hash queues a Pipeline Run; with precomputed, it doesn't.
verification: pytest: live + new document → run queued; live + same hash → no run; precomputed → no run
notes: Never generates per user.

title: Live mode periodically re-fetches URL sources
user_visible_behavior: URL Source Documents are re-fetched at a configured interval; a changed hash updates the document and triggers regeneration.
verification: pytest with a mocked HTTP response and a controlled clock: changed content → new hash + run queued; same content → nothing
notes: The interval is configurable (e.g. 6h).
